experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly VWAP exhibits mean reversion when deviating by more than 3% from its 30-period average, due to micro-liquidity frictions in high-frequency order flow imbalances.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 30-minute rolling window, if BTC-USD hourly VWAP deviates by more than 3% from its 30-period mean and remains above/below the mean for at least 10 consecutive hours without reversion, the hypothesis is falsified.
